claims_boundary: This crosswalk maps public requirement signals to current Worldshepherd evidence and gaps. It does not claim government acceptance, award, superiority, CUI authorization, CMMC status, classified capability, or operational-scale performance.

worldshepherd_evidence: SARA governed workflow and audit primitives
PRE schema and qualification evidence compiler
gaps: open-source licensing/business decision for the Phase-II commercial open-source requirement

auditable history linking condition source data recommendation operator decision action and outcome is highly desirable
commercially derived data-integration and decision-support platforms are responsive
synthetic Phase-I data may conform to ASPN or pntOS
gaps: current Navy Q&A states all Phase-I data and activity is CUI
public Sara_pro is not an authorized CUI environment
projected CMMC Level 2 Self evidence not established
operator UX and ASPN/pntOS integration demonstration

public_requirement_signals: transparent reasoning confidence scoring and data provenance
20-30 MB/min nominal ingest and about 5 GB/min burst handling
Top Secret/SCI personnel and facility clearance path
worldshepherd_evidence: deterministic synthetic fusion with observation lineage
gaps: real Multi-INT data and production fusion performance

public_requirement_signals: revolutionary information-processing research rather than incremental product improvement
AI and resilient complex-system research themes

open-source licensing decision remains unresolved where required
